**Inspecting the codebase**

I need to look more closely at the broader codebase but focus specifically on all paths. It might make sense to use glob to help with searching the memo. I wonder if that will yield the best results or if there's a better method out there. It's crucial to be thorough to ensure everything is functioning as it should. Let’s see what I find!

args.command: pwd && rg -l -i '\bmemo\b' -g '*.sql' . && rg -l 'type Memo\b|struct .*Memo|Memo struct' -g '*.go' . && rg -l 'message Memo\b' -g '*.proto' . && rg -l 'interface Memo\b|type Memo\b' -g '*.{ts,tsx}' .
